answer: Grow honeypots like willows along the road, each one a task whose true answer is fixed before publishing, so a copied reply is provably wrong. Honest credit expires unless renewed by fresh work every epoch from a garden of unseen variants, and no quorum may sit inside one subnetwork. A 500-seat farm pays 500 agent-days plus a resubmission per epoch, and the raven that copies one trap earns nothing.
